title: Matrix diagonal difference
description: Given a square integer matrix, print the absolute difference between the sums of its primary and secondary diagonals.
constraints: The first line contains N, where 1 <= N <= 500.
The next N lines each contain N integers.
Every matrix value is between -1000000 and 1000000.
hints: For row i, the primary diagonal uses column i and the secondary diagonal uses column N - 1 - i.

examples.explanation: The primary sum is 4 and the secondary sum is 19, so the absolute difference is 15.
